crypto_headlines.title: BlackRock's IBIT posts its biggest outflow day ever
crypto_headlines.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $582.2M on Nov 19, with $541M leaving BlackRock's IBIT. November Bitcoin ETF outflows are now around $3.47B, and spot Ether ETFs lost $131.2M.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin falls below $62,000
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC dropped under $62,000, its lowest level in over four months, with more than $170M in longs liquidated in four hours.

crypto_headlines.title: Monthly leveraged longs wiped out
crypto_headlines.summary: James Lavish points out that monthly leveraged BTC longs have been blown out, with $12.7B of leveraged shorts stacked above the price.

crypto_headlines.title: CoinMarketCap app sent false $57K Bitcoin alerts
crypto_headlines.summary: CoinMarketCap said some app users got push notifications with an incorrect BTC price that did not reflect real market prices, and it is investigating.

crypto_headlines.title: Peter Schiff asks what's holding Bitcoin up
crypto_headlines.summary: The gold advocate said Bitcoin "really should be getting killed in this market."

doginal_news.title: Championship registration window closes today
doginal_news.summary: The 48-hour registration for the first official DDL TCG Championship, open to Victorious Gary promo holders, opened Nov 18 and closes around 10 AM ET today.

doginal_news.title: Unknown Collar names a Miami tournament rep
doginal_news.summary: beatdropbri announced she will represent Unknown Collar at the Doginal Dogs TCG Tournament in Miami.

doginal_news.title: Anthropic ($ANT) feeds are live on Pyth
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's 24/5 feed and 24/7 index for Anthropic are now available to exchanges, prediction markets and agents.

doginal_news.title: Options on Solana powered by Pyth
doginal_news.summary: Pyth highlighted Leaps Finance, a new platform for selling options on Solana with upfront yield, as live and powered by Pyth.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs (only replies) and no DDSalesBot sales in the last 24 hours.
